summary: Zinc supports immune function, wound healing and taste. Serum zinc falls during any inflammation independently of body stores, so a low result during illness is difficult to interpret.
what_it_measures: The concentration of zinc in blood serum, reported in umol/L.

interpretations.meaning: A low zinc can cause slow wound healing, altered taste, hair thinning and more frequent infections, but the result must be read alongside CRP because inflammation lowers it artificially.

when_to_seek_help: Interpret zinc alongside CRP. A low value measured during an infection usually needs repeating rather than treating.
approved_by: Demo dataset (illustrative values, not for clinical use)
